'''Fotane''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Merchant/Legends|dealer]] who worked at the [[Kelada starport]]. [[Loh'khar]] the Finder arranged a favor for him with [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] customs. Loh'khar collected on the favor by requesting an [[MD-series medical droid/Legends|MD-series medical specialist droid]].<ref name="FF" />
